name: Rucandio (Spain)
description: Square flag of blue, yellow and green horizontal stripes with thin white and blue stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rucandio (a tree on yellow above a sheep on green).
history: Municipal flag of Rucandio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Rucandio arms — tree above a sheep
